title: feedback --list shows legacy 'open' status instead of the ticket's derived state
detail: Adopter walkthrough 2026-07-27: prusik feedback --list rendered 8 findings as 'open' while their tickets were verified-closed (derive_state). The list reads the legacy jsonl status field — a second source of truth that goes stale the moment the ticket loop closes a finding. Adopters see a lying scoreboard right after prusik update closes their findings.
repro: cd adopter-repo && prusik feedback --list  # states disagree with prusik feedback show <id>
